class.name: NNBTActionLeaf
class.brief_description: Base class for behaviour tree action leaves that perform work.
class.description: Use for custom behaviour tree actions that perform work and may return [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING] across multiple ticks before returning [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] or [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE]. For instant yes/no checks, use [NNBTConditionLeaf] instead.
